text:
PagerDutyBot: Incident alert: high tail latency + 500s on hosted inference (prod). Observed spike 03:02 UTC affecting model redwood-xl-13b-quant in eu-west-1. Error rate 500s up from 0.2% -> 6%. paging oncall (@maya).
Maya (oncall): on it. i'm grabbing logs + tracing. starting a short-lived channel for mitigation, will post updates here.
InfraBot: rolling aggregated logs for pool prod-inference-eu: show 2xx -> 500 transition around 03:01:45. top errors: "kv_cache_miss: invalid_kv_size" and "tensor_recv_failure".
Sanjay: seeing kv eviction storms in the runtime metrics. hypothesis: recent quant kernel change + large prefix workloads == kv cache thrash -> malformed buffers. pulling commit that rolled two kernel patches: `commit a9f3b2e` (quant kernel).
Drew: can we toggle kv cache for prod pool to stop thrashing? suggest `./opsctl runtime toggle-kvcache --pool=prod-inference-eu --enable=false` as short-term. also reduce batch size to limit concurrent kv growth.
Maya (oncall): executing toggle now.
Maya (oncall) [run command]: ```
$ ./opsctl runtime toggle-kvcache --pool=prod-inference-eu --enable=false
result: success; kv cache disabled for pool prod-inference-eu at 03:07:12 UTC
```
Maya (oncall): reduced batching thresholds to max_tokens_per_batch=64 and max_concurrent_batches=8 for affected pool. posting metrics in 2m.
Olivia: Customer-facing note: we have reports of 10-30s response times for several EU customers and intermittent 500s. Opened INC-4921 and added a short status message on support dashboard: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-4921. tagging legal for regulated customers.
Priya: need a quick customer impact assessment for paid accounts. which tenants saw 500s vs high latency? can we get a list / SLA hit estimate?
Sanjay: initial query: tenants with >1% 500s in last 10m: acme-corp, luminous-ai, marketlytics. rolling 99th latency returned to baseline after kv-cache toggle but 95th still slightly elevated. root cause hypothesis: quant kernel change introduced edge-case in kv-size computation causing eviction loop under heavy prefix reuse.
Theo: confirmed a repro locally: long prefix > 16k tokens + quantized attention kernels produce kv chunk size mismatch leading to a downstream buffer resize panic. created a small failing test and attached stacktrace. recommendation: rollback quant kernel patch OR gate it behind canary.
Drew: initiated model fallback for critical tenants: routing critical keys to redwood-xl-13b-fp16 (non-quant) for EU region via routing rule: `route.override(tenant in critical_list) -> model=redwood-xl-13b-fp16`. applied at 03:12 UTC.
Oncall-bot: mitigation summary: kv cache disabled, reduced batching, model fallback for critical tenants applied. Monitoring for 30m.
Maya (oncall): can everyone run smoke tests and post results? I'm watching latency, errors, and CPU/GPU utilization.
Sanjay: smoke results: 99pct tokens latency dropped from 2.8s -> 0.9s; 500s errors reduced to <0.5% after mitigation. still seeing occasional errors on very long prefixes; suspect incomplete rollback surface.
Olivia: customers acme-corp and luminous-ai still reporting intermittent 500s on long multi-turn sessions. opened tickets and escalated. prepping outreach template now.
Priya: scheduling post-incident review: propose 14:00 UTC tomorrow. Sanjay to lead RCA. please confirm owners and action items in-thread.
Sanjay: accepting postmortem owner. immediate action items (initial):
  - "Fix kv eviction / size calc bug" — owner: Sanjay — ETA: 5d — Jira: RINF-789
  - "Gate quant kernel rollout with canary + perf tests" — owner: Theo — ETA: 10d — Jira: RINF-790
  - "Alerting: detect kv thrash pattern and auto-mitigate" — owner: Drew — ETA: 3d — Jira: RINF-791
  - "Customer comms + impact spreadsheet" — owner: Olivia — ETA: 2d — Jira: RINF-792
  - "Add mixed long-prefix regression tests to CI" — owner: Theo — ETA: 7d — Jira: RINF-793
Drew: i'll add an automated runbook step to auto-toggle kv cache when eviction rate > X for 3m; will link PR to RINF-791.
Maya (oncall): adding these to handoff notes. handing to Priya (product ops) to drive customer comms and follow-ups. pls keep this thread updated with PR links.
Theo: plan for kernel change: add canary lane limited to synthetic traffic + long prefix fuzzing. also add binary compatibility guard to kv code path to avoid size mismatch.
Priya: confirmed postmortem scheduled 14:00 UTC tomorrow. Olivia, please prepare customer impact sheet (tenants, SLA delta, credits suggested).
Olivia: will have CSV and email draft by EOD. also adding a short status page update draft: "Mitigation applied; rolling fix in progress; follow-up postmortem scheduled."
InfraBot: auto-generated follow-ups: linked Jira tasks RINF-789,RINF-790,RINF-791,RINF-792,RINF-793. pinned incident thread and assigned follow-up review in calendar.
Sanjay: mitigation is temporary. please do not close incident until RC/patch is deployed and validated in canary and eu region.
Drew: suggested public status message (proposal):
```
We experienced elevated latency and intermittent 500 responses in EU region due to a runtime regression interacting with quantized kernels and KV cache under long-prefix workloads. Mitigations applied to restore stability; detailed postmortem to follow.
```
Maya (oncall): summary: mitigation sequence -> toggle kv cache, reduce batch thresholds, model fallback for critical tenants. outcome -> errors and tail latency largely recovered; customer impact limited to a small set of tenants with long sessions. Postmortem owner Sanjay, meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC, action items captured as above. handing off to Priya for customer outreach and Theo/Sanjay/Drew to track remediation engineering work.
Priya: noted, will coordinate customer comms and update INC-4921.
Oncall-bot: closing paging loop for now; incident remains open for engineering remediation.
Maya (oncall): thanks all — please update your Jira owners and comment PR links in this thread so we have a single source for follow-up. reconvene after initial fixes. :thumbsup:
